title: Zabardast
description: Ratan steals diamonds for a gangster, Balram Singh, but after learning about the latter's evil intentions, he decides to keep them. Later, believing his family to be dead, Ratan goes on the run.

title: An Evening In Paris
description: A wealthy woman meets a charming but not completely truthful beau in France.

title: Neend Hamari Khwab Tumhare
description: Nishad, who belongs to a noble Muslim family, is in love with Anwar. When everything seems to be working in their favour, a secret from Anwar's family threatens to end their relationship.

title: Haathkadi
description: An inspector hires four juveniles to kidnap a politician as he wants to usurp the minister's property. The juveniles have other plans for the politician, who was responsible for them going to jail.

title: Ghulam
description: Jai runs errands for Ronak Singh who is a gang lord and is involved in illegal activities. Jai's brother Siddharth decides to revolt against him and Ronak after some things goes lethally awry.

title: Conversation With Javed Akhtar 2
description: Lyricist, poet, screenwriter, Javed Akhtar along with film expert Nasreen Ali and Shabana Azmi, provides a fascinating and personal insight into his extraordinary life and new book Talking Life.

title: Gardish
description: A peace-loving man has to resort to violence when his father is beaten up by mobsters.

title: Santaan
description: Sarju and Laxmi have done everything to educate their son Amar and have lots of hope from him but the but he desires to become rich and disowns his parents who then face only sufferings in their life.

title: Conversation With Javed Akhtar 2
description: Lyricist, poet, screenwriter, Javed Akhtar along with film expert Nasreen Ali and Shabana Azmi, provides a fascinating and personal insight into his extraordinary life and new book Talking Life.

title: Gehri Chaal
description: Shekhar threatens to expose Ratan's secret if he does not help him in a heist. A desperate Ratan assists Shekhar, but ends up becoming the prime suspect.

title: Conversation With Javed Akhtar 2
description: Lyricist, poet, screenwriter, Javed Akhtar along with film expert Nasreen Ali and Shabana Azmi, provides a fascinating and personal insight into his extraordinary life and new book Talking Life.

title: Majhdhaar
description: Krishna loves Radha but they cannot marry against their parent's wishes. Although she is pregnant with Krishna's child, circumstances lead Radha to marry Gopal.

title: Gair
description: An abandoned child raised by a wealthy family takes over the family business. He is resented by their natural son who, fueled by a bitter uncle, tries his best to make him lose face.

title: Amanush
description: A village youth falsely implicated in a conspiracy is imprisoned and can't prove his innocence to his beloved. Devastated, he takes to alcohol.

title: Professor Ki Padosan
description: Vidyadhar consumes a potion to become invisible in order to escape his wife Shobha's ire when she learns of his affair with Menka.

title: Phool
description: Dharamraaj (Rajendra Kumar) and Balram Choudhary (Sunil Dutt) are two friends who earn their living by farming. To cement their friendship both fathers fix their children's wedding.

title: Jurrat
description: Inspector Avinash is transferred to Mumbai and is tasked to nab smuggler Kama Seth. When Kama hoodwinks Avinash and makes him a laughing stock in the eyes of the media, he makes a dangerous decision.

title: Love 86
description: A strict mother tries to marry off her daughters, Leena and Isha, to two brothers from a well-off family, but they prefer two down-and-out thieves.
